qualitative.gate_2_reason: Operating revenue and banking assets are entirely concentrated in non-Western emerging markets (Georgia and Uzbekistan), subject to severe geopolitical instability, regional tension, and developing-market rule-of-law risks.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (REJECT). TBC Bank Group is a UK-listed holding company whose entire underlying banking and fintech operations are located in Georgia (~85-90% of assets) and Uzbekistan, failing the Western essential need standard and exposing equity holders to heightened Caucasus/Central Asian geopolitical and rule-of-law risks.
qualitative.evidence: TBC is Georgia's largest financial institution with ~39% market share in loans and deposits, expanding into Uzbekistan digital retail banking. Despite high reported ROE (>25%), the franchise operates entirely within developing Eurasian economies subject to severe political turbulence (e.g., Georgian foreign agent laws, regional Russian tensions) outside Western rule-of-law protections.
